app.name: GameExplorer
app.tagline: Your game library on the NAS

help.dropHint: You can also drop files anywhere

errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.conflict: It cannot be done right now.
errors.igdbUnavailable: IGDB is not answering; try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.loadBody: Check the connection to the NAS and try again.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

health.libraryBody: You can browse and download, but not upload or change anything. Check the dataset permissions in TrueNAS (the app's user needs “Modify”).
health.genericBody: Some features may fail until it is fixed.

home.emptyLibrary: Your library is empty. Drop files on the window or use “Upload games” to start.

search.title: Search
search.prompt: Type a game's name. Case and accents do not matter.
search.noMatchBody: Search ignores case and accents. Try fewer words.

console.emptyBody: Upload an archive or the game's files. {{name}} will come preselected.

game.missingBanner_one: A file is no longer on disk (deleted or moved over SMB). Copy it back to the game folder, or use “Forget” to remove it from the library.
game.missingBanner_other: {{count}} items are no longer on disk (deleted or moved over SMB). Copy them back to the game folder, or use “Forget” to remove them from the library.
game.trashBody: You can restore it from Settings › Trash until it is purged.
game.forgetBody: “{{name}}” is removed from the library. Its files are no longer on disk, so nothing is deleted.
game.dropHint: Drop an Update or DLC here, or use “Add games”: {{console}} will come preselected
game.goneBody: It was moved to the trash or merged into another one.

rematch.title: Change IGDB game
rematch.pickFirst: Choose the right game to see how the folder and files will look.
rematch.same: That is the game it already has. Choose another one.
rematch.smbFollow: Files you added over SMB move with the folder.
rematch.mergeBanner: You already have “{{title}}” on this console: both games will merge into {{path}}. Decide what to do with what is already there.
rematch.skip: Skip this one (it goes to the trash)

igdb.typeMore: Type at least 2 letters to search IGDB.
igdb.unavailable: IGDB is not answering; try again.
igdb.unconfiguredBody: Choosing the game needs Twitch credentials. Add IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET to the app in TrueNAS and restart it. The upload waits in review.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.needsYou: An upload is waiting for you
uploads.none: No uploads. Drop files or choose some to start.
uploads.wrongFile: That is not the file: {{name}} ({{size}}) was expected.
uploads.waitingParts: Waiting for the other parts · part {{part}} received

drop.body: Archives are extracted for you. Then you choose the game on IGDB and the app stores it in its folder.
drop.noFolders: Folders cannot be uploaded: compress them first (zip, 7z or rar).

review.title: Review upload
review.matchesHeader: Matches the detection from the file's contents
review.matchesExtension: Matches the detection from the extension
review.unknownConsole: The console was not recognized: choose it.
review.consoleFirst: Choose the console first: the search is limited to it.
review.storedAsPending: Choose the console and the game to see the final name
review.replace: Replace (the current one goes to the trash)
review.cancelBody: The uploaded and extracted files of “{{name}}” are deleted. This cannot be undone.
review.goneBody: It may have been cancelled or purged.

state.done: This upload is already in the library
state.busy: This upload is still being processed
state.body: Its status is shown in Uploads.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionBody: This device remembers the session until you sign out.
settings.igdb: Game data, covers and logos come from IGDB.com. The app does not distribute games.

consoles.orderHint: Use the arrows to change the carousel order
consoles.name: Display name
consoles.folderHint: Lower case, digits, - and _. The folder inside the library.
consoles.slugLocked: The console has games: its folder cannot change.
consoles.deleteBlocked: {{name}} has games: it cannot be deleted
consoles.deleteBody: It leaves the carousel. The {{folder}} folder is not touched.
consoles.deleteInUse: The console still has games (those in the trash count too).
consoles.rules: A console's folder can only change while it has no games. Only consoles you added and that are empty (in the trash too) can be deleted.
consoles.addHint: New consoles are detected by extension only; you can always confirm or change the console when uploading.
consoles.added: {{name}} was added at the end of the carousel.
consoles.taken: That folder or that platform is already in use.
consoles.badSlug: Use lower case, digits, - and _ (32 at most).
consoles.badExtension: An extension is a dot and letters or digits, like .z64.

trash.retention_one: Deleted for good after a day
trash.replaced: Replaced when another copy was uploaded
trash.deleteBody: {{size}} are freed. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirmBody_one: {{count}} item is deleted for good and {{size}} are freed. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirmBody_other: {{count}} items are deleted for good and {{size}} are freed. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyBody: What you send here can be restored until it is purged.
trash.conflictBody: You stored another copy after trashing it. If you restore “{{title}}”, the current one goes to the trash.

integrity.title: Library integrity
integrity.never: Checked at start and every hour. No check has run yet.
integrity.ok: Checked every hour. Last check: {{when}} · everything in place.
integrity.missing_one: Last check: {{when}} · {{count}} item is missing from disk.
integrity.missing_other: Last check: {{when}} · {{count}} items are missing from disk.
